title: protoboard-iso operations
description: A batch of operations, applied atomically (all or none).

pins.description: Holes for the leads: a list in the part's pin order, or an object by pin name. Holes: a1…j63 (a1…t63 on a double board), rails T+3, B-12… (U+3 on a double board)

oneOf.description: Any part field except id and pins; null deletes the field
One string per language code, e.g. { "en": "…", "es": "…" }

lang.description: Language of everything made from this circuit: drawing labels, the page, messages. A language asked for explicitly (--lang, MCP lang) wins.

supplies.description: Simulation: where the power comes from, besides battery parts. The first supply's negative is ground (0 V); with none, the first battery part's.

kind.description: battery: like a battery part (format, chemistry, cells, charge), or only a voltage (0.25 Ω per 1.5 V cell unless given); generator: a signal generator (waveform, frequency, amplitude, offset, resistance)

amplitude.description: generator: peak volts (half of peak to peak), default 1

positive.description: hole or node of the + lead, default "T+"

negative.description: hole or node of the − lead, default "T-"

currentLimit.description: bench supply current limit, amperes (constant current above it)

environment.description: The world the sensors read (docs/en/environment.md), shared by every part that senses a field: a number, or { value, program }. A part's own value ("light": 50 on the part) wins over it

light.description: lx, 0.1…10000 on the slider, 0…1000000 at most, default 300

program.description: Changes the field with simulated time: toggle, cycle, ramp, keyframes

oneOf.description: high for `on` s, then low for `off` s, starting high at t = 0

shape.description: a signal generator's: sine starts in the middle rising, square high first, triangle at the bottom (default sine)

oneOf.description: from → to in `seconds`, then holds `to`

points.description: [[t, value], …], t in s going up: straight lines between them, the last one held

loop.description: start again after the last point

range.description: [min, max]: the span the slider and the indicator show (inside 0…1000000, min < max, min above 0); default 0.1…10000

simulation.description: false: no simulation in the page at all (a value the learner must predict first). By default a circuit with a source gets it

results.description: Simulation results always on in the page (default: true with a source): the tapped part shows its values on the board and in its card, its oscilloscope and limits; LEDs light up. false turns them off

flow.description: The current layer as a button in the bar, not pressed (default: true with a source): everything dimmed, conductors coloured by voltage, moving dots. false leaves it out; { style } keeps it and chooses how it is drawn: 'plan' (default: at board level, a pad at every landing, a line through two-pin parts and jumpers, a stub per pin on the others) or 'real' (along the leads and through the bodies)

focus.description: Parts in focus when the page opens (the ones being explained)

controls.description: Live page: a panel with the controls a lesson puts in front (every adjustable part also has its own in its card). Each names a part or a supply and one of its controls: resistance (resistor), temperature (thermistor), light (photoresistor), position (potentiometer), pressed (push button, momentary), voltage (bench supply), charge (battery), frequency and amplitude (signal generator), threshold and its own stimulus (sensor-module)

supply.description: id of a supply (a drawn battery: use part)

environment.description: a field of the circuit's environment (instead of part or supply and field), shown with its indicator in the panel's Environment section

min.description: slider start, in the unit of the field (ohms, °C, lux, 0…1, volts)

environment.description: The whole environment (every field it has) in the side panel, each with its indicator and, for a field a program moves, Pause and Resume (default: true when a part follows a field of it)

theme.description: Colours of the page: 'auto' follows the system (default); 'light' or 'dark' (the bench), 'notebook' (cream paper, a blue grid) or 'stage' (the notebook at night, the videos') fix them. The reader's choice in the page's menu and a link's ?theme= win over this

tour.description: The timeline the page plays as *See how it works* (and a video is made from): the name of a JSON file beside the circuit (timeline.schema.json), read only from its folder, or the timeline itself

focusView.description: A part's view up close (the live page): the card of a part offers it, and the part goes alone on its pedestal with its pins, bench, symbol and inside view a tap away (default false)

start.description: Live simulation (with results or flow): 'dc' opens at the DC values (default); 'zero' switches on at t = 0 with capacitors discharged and runs

spec.description: What layout was asked for, kept so the circuit can be laid out again (layout on an existing target) and so review can check the connections: nets of pin references, supplies that name pins, and the ids of the jumpers layout added

wires.description: jumpers added by layout (not parts of the spec)

recipe.description: The recipe the circuit was laid out from (src/recipes/), with the values given; gone once it is laid out again with other parts or nets
